from datetime import datetime

content = note.get('content','')
print('note_title:', note.get('title'))
print('note_updated_at:', note.get('updated_at'))
print('content_lines:', len(content.splitlines()))

shares = {}
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('-') and '=>' in line:
        # format: - Adrian => $36
        parts = line.lstrip('-').strip().split('=>')
        if len(parts)==2:
            name = parts[0].strip()
            amt_str = parts[1].strip()
            amt_str = amt_str.replace('$','').strip()
            try:
                amt = float(amt_str)
            except Exception:
                continue
            shares[name]=amt

# Use previously fetched variables if present

# Ensure we have shares from note 3084
note_shares = globals().get('shares')
if not note_shares:
    raise RuntimeError('shares not found')

approved = globals().get('approved_received')
if not approved:
    raise RuntimeError('approved_received not found')

# Compute paid set by sender first name and exact amount match
paid_names=set()
matched=[]
for item in approved:
    sender=item.get('sender') or {}
    sender_name=sender.get('name') or ''
    sender_first=sender_name.strip().split(' ')[0] if sender_name.strip() else ''
    amt=item.get('amount')
    # compare with each share name by exact first-name match and amount match
    for name, share_amt in note_shares.items():
        if sender_first.lower()==name.lower() and abs(float(amt)-float(share_amt))<1e-9:
            paid_names.add(name)
            matched.append({'name':name,'sender_name':sender_name,'email':sender.get('email'),'amount':amt,'payment_request_id':item.get('payment_request_id')})

print('paid_names:', paid_names)
print('unpaid_names:', [n for n in note_shares.keys() if n not in paid_names])
print('matched_examples_count:', len(matched))
# print per name best match
from collections import defaultdict
best=defaultdict(list)
for m in matched:
    best[m['name']].append(m)
for n in note_shares.keys():
    if n in best:
        print('paid', n, 'share', note_shares[n], 'matches:', best[n])

# Fetch Venmo RECEIVED transactions around the dinner date range with optional query 'Friends Dinner'
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [c1d3a0]: applying this strategy to identify already-paid contributors and act only on unpaid subset</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure whether Venmo payments include memo text 'Friends Dinner'; start with it, then fall back</uncertainty>

min_date='2023-05-18'
max_date='2023-05-20'
query_text='Friends Dinner'

def fetch_all_received_transactions(query=None):
    all_tx=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        kwargs=dict(access_token=venmo_token, direction='received', min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if query is not None:
            kwargs['query']=query
        tx=apis.venmo.show_transactions(**kwargs)
        print('page',page_index,'count',len(tx),'query',query)
        if not tx:
            break
        all_tx.extend(tx)
        page_index += 1
    return all_tx

# First try with query
try_tx = fetch_all_received_transactions(query=query_text)

from datetime import datetime

max_date='2023-05-21'

# fetch all received transactions in widened range without query
all_recv_tx=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='received', min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_recv_tx.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total received tx widened:',len(all_recv_tx))
for t in sorted(all_recv_tx, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at','')):
    sender=t.get('sender') or {}
    print('id',t.get('transaction_id'),'amt',t.get('amount'),'desc', (t.get('description') or '')[:25],'date',t.get('created_at'),'sender',sender.get('name'),sender.get('email'))

# Compute paid shares by matching sender email and amount
share_by_name = note_shares
phone_by_name = phone_by_name  # from earlier

paid=set()
paid_matches=[]
for tx in all_recv_tx:
    sender_email=(tx.get('sender') or {}).get('email')
    amt=tx.get('amount')
    for name, email in phone_by_name.items():
        if sender_email==email and abs(float(amt)-float(share_by_name[name]))<1e-9:
            paid.add(name)
            paid_matches.append({'name':name,'tx_id':tx.get('transaction_id'),'amt':amt,'desc':tx.get('description'),'date':tx.get('created_at')})

print('paid names:',paid)
print('paid_matches:',paid_matches)
unpaid=[n for n in share_by_name.keys() if n not in paid]
